Subject: The Ridgeline 2P is back — your next trip just got easier to plan
Preview: 2.1 kg, 3-season ready, ripstop nylon. Back in stock now.
Body: If you had the Ridgeline 2P on your list and missed it last time, it's back.

Here's what it does: shelters two people across three seasons at 2.1 kg total packed weight. The ripstop nylon shell handles rain, wind, and the kind of weather that shows up uninvited on a Thursday night in the backcountry. It's not built for winter mountaineering or sustained storm exposure — this is a 3-season tent, and it performs that role well.

Two people, 2.1 kg, ripstop nylon construction. No frills added to the story.

Stock moved fast before. If the Ridgeline fits your next trip, now's the time.
